notes.title: EASTER EGG UPDATE!
notes.content:
GO FIND THE EASTER EGG!

It is somewhere in the game, unlocking a permanent good looking skin!

More updates to come, stay tuned!

notes.title: Release date pushed back: December 20th
notes.content:
[b][u]A few tweaks need to be made before releasing this game. 
[/u][/b]
Its too buggy and incomplete, but will still be out very soon, as I have been hard at work with these issues. 

Thank you so much for being here, and make sure to wishlist to be reminded on December 21 when the game comes out!
